_comment: Legacy friction-ledger debt frozen at gate go-live (ADR-0544). This baseline is the shrink-only ratchet reference for the schema/orphan/closure codes whose keys exist in the ledger TODAY. The live-repo gate test asserts the MEASURED legacy set equals these keys EXACTLY (set equality, not a count): a NEW friction triggering any of these codes is born-blocking because it is not in the baseline, while the frozen legacy keys age out as their rows are fixed (evidence added / fields filled / primary logged). This file is NOT producer-regenerated — it is a reviewed, hand-shrunk artifact. The anti-laundering property is REVIEW-VISIBLE, not structural (FRIC-1781112000 follow-up): because this file (and the test's ceilings) are same-PR-editable, laundering new debt requires a visible edit to a frozen file that a reviewer must approve — the ratchet does not yet mechanically compare against origin/dev (a baseline-shrink-only meta-gate is the named follow-up). Removing a key here is allowed only when that friction is genuinely fixed; adding a key requires an explicit reviewed edit and is the only sanctioned way the set grows (it should only ever shrink). The closure-integrity frozen-empty codes (friction_duplicate_primary_row, friction_unknown_status, friction_policy_gate_id_mismatch) and the born-blocking-clean friction_no_disposition carry NO baseline: any key is RED.
